pages.quiz:
ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 30
   C. 20
   D. 75

2. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.6
   C. 19
   D. 19.7

3. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. Cannot tell

4. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 5
   C. 8
   D. 16

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 55
   C. 32
   D. 22

6. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23.6
   C. 23.7
   D. 23

7. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x

8. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 21
   C. 15
   D. 15.6

9. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31.7
   C. 31
   D. 37

10. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 2
   D. 1

11. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 31

12. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
